evaluation.head: Subroutine Suspendable Cocinar(plato As String, precio As Integer, porciones As Integer) As Integer
blocks: Define frutas As Task<Integer> <- Spawn Cocinar("frutas", 2, 4);
Define sandwiches As Task<Integer> <- Spawn Cocinar("sándwiches", 5, 2);
Define jugos As Task<Integer> <- Spawn Cocinar("jugos", 3, 3);
Write "Bandeja: ", Await jugos + Await sandwiches + Await frutas, " pesos";
